auto_confirm.title: Confirm bookings made by the guest automatically
auto_confirm.description: When on, a reservation the guest booked herself — online or through an automation such as WhatsApp — is created already confirmed, so nobody has to accept it one by one. Turn it off to review every one of them before the table is held. Plainly `boolean` and required: the wide settings form declares this field nullable because there NULL means «leave it alone», and a door that exists to set this one value has no such meaning to express.
